optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Customer Support Team Lead, Help Desk Software
professionalSummary: Seasoned support team lead with two years of experience managing a tier‑one team of seven agents, responsible for shift scheduling, queue management, coaching, escalation, and metrics reporting. Proven ability to align team operations with quality rubrics and escalation procedures while maintaining clear documentation and communication with senior management.
experienceHighlights: Led shift rota and queue assignments for a tier‑one support team of seven agents, using the workforce tool to schedule weekly shifts.
Coached agents on ticket handling against the company’s quality rubric, conducting weekly quality reviews and recording coaching notes in agent files.
Escalated tier‑two issues following the escalation procedure, documenting responsibility boundaries for each escalation.
Reported weekly response and resolution metrics to the support manager via the ticketing system dashboard, filing reports in the team folder.
Managed hiring, pay, and disciplinary matters through the support manager, focusing on rota, coaching, escalation, and reporting responsibilities.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Provided one month’s shift rotas, a weekly quality review record with coaching notes, and four weekly metrics reports, all linked to the ticketing system and workforce tool as verification trails.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample confirm the candidate’s experience in shift scheduling, queue assignment, coaching, escalation, and metrics reporting for a tier‑one support team, but do not provide evidence of documentation of hand‑over conditions or open issues for the support manager.

evidence.text: Team lead for a tier-one support team of seven agents at a software company for two years, setting the shift rota and the queue assignments each week in the workforce tool.
Work sample: one month's shift rotas, ...

Coached the agents on ticket handling against the company's quality rubric, running the weekly quality review with the quality team's sampled tickets and recording the coaching notes in the agents' files.
Work sample: ... weekly quality review record with coaching notes
Escalated tier-two issues under the escalation procedure through the escalation queue, recording in each escalation which checks were mine and which belonged to the tier-two engineer.
Reported the team's response and resolution metrics to the support manager each week from the ticketing system's dashboard, with the weekly reports filed in the team folder.
Work sample: ... four weekly metrics reports
Hiring, pay and disciplinary matters for the agents stayed with the support manager; my role covered rota, coaching, escalation and reporting.
